tldr: 美國5月非農爆表澆熄降息預期，費半單日重挫逾10%，台股開盤一度爆出史上最大盤中跌點。
台指期夜盤崩跌後，期交所自6/9起辦說明會，宣導7/6上路的兩大避險新制。
Biotech became the week's safe haven as AI and chip names pulled back, with 藥華藥 and 保瑞 both posting record monthly revenue.
AI與晶片股漲多回檔，生醫族群成本周避風港，藥華藥、保瑞5月營收同創新高。
金管會同步收緊壽險海外垃圾債部位，並盯緊社群平台兜售的境外地下保單。
以色列再襲伊朗石化廠，布蘭特原油勁揚近5%，地緣政治風險升溫。

items.title_zh: 台股爆2,694點史上最大盤中跌點，台積電開盤秒殺
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks post record intraday point loss as TSMC tumbles
items.summary_zh: 受美股上週五費半暴跌10.26%衝擊，台股6月8日開盤跌破45,000點，盤中一度重挫2,694點，創下史上最大盤中跌點紀錄；台指期夜盤更已先行崩跌逾3,000點。權值王台積電開盤直接跌至約2,230元、跌幅超過一根停板，旺矽、弘塑、聯亞等多檔千金股同步亮燈跌停，市場恐慌情緒濃厚。統一投顧提醒投資人此刻應優先做好風險控管、提高現金部位，不宜貿然搶進承接，待外部利空鈍化、量能回穩後再評估布局，避免在急殺段被洗出場。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX cratered as much as 2,694 points intraday on June 8, its largest-ever intraday point decline, after Friday's 10.26% plunge in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index. The index broke below 45,000, while TAIFEX night-session futures had already crashed more than 3,000 points. TSMC opened sharply lower at around NT$2,230, down more than a full daily limit move, and a string of "thousand-dollar" stocks including 旺矽, 弘塑 and 聯亞 hit limit-down. President Securities Investment Consulting urged investors to prioritise risk control and raise cash positions rather than bottom-fish into the panic.

items.title_zh: 台股殺盤襲來，17檔法人逆勢狂掃貨
items.title_en: Foreign and institutional money keeps buying 17 names into the selloff
items.summary_zh: 台股6月8日跳空回檔之際，外資與投信法人仍逆勢加碼一籃子撐盤股，由倍微（6270）、玉晶光（3406）領軍的17檔個股可望成為盤面穩定要角，其中玉晶光更獲法人連續買超15個交易日，籌碼面相對穩固。不過整體利空仍不容小覷，台指期夜盤大幅跳空下跌、記憶體族群盤中閃崩，顯示法人選擇性承接是在大盤明顯偏空的氛圍下進行；投資人宜留意法人鎖定的逆勢買超標的與基本面是否相符，作為急跌段觀察名單，而非全面進場訊號。
items.summary_en: As the TAIEX gapped lower on June 8, institutional investors were still accumulating a basket of 17 supporting stocks led by 倍微 (6270) and 玉晶光 (3406), positioning them as potential stabilising anchors during the rout. 玉晶光 in particular drew a 15-straight-session institutional buying streak. The market still faced heavy headwinds, however, with the night-session futures gapping sharply lower and memory-related names flash-crashing, underscoring that selective institutional support was running against a broadly risk-off tape.

items.title_en: Three active ETFs list on June 9, lifting market count to 223
items.summary_zh: 主動安聯美國科技（00402A）、主動聯博動能50（00404A）、主動富邦台灣龍耀（00405A）三檔主動式ETF於6月9日同步在集中市場掛牌，自掛牌首日起即可進行融資融券交易。三檔上市後，台灣集中市場ETF總數達223檔，其中被動型195檔、主動型28檔，顯示主動式ETF版圖在大盤波動之際仍持續擴張。對投資人而言，主動式ETF結合經理人選股與ETF交易便利性，但內扣費用與追蹤策略各異，布局前仍須留意其投資範疇、波動度與費用結構，避免僅以「主動」名號作為進場依據。
items.summary_en: Three actively managed ETFs debut on the Taiwan exchange on June 9: 主動安聯美國科技 (00402A), 主動聯博動能50 (00404A) and 主動富邦台灣龍耀 (00405A), all eligible for margin trading and short selling from their first trading day. Their listing brings the total number of exchange-listed ETFs to 223, comprising 195 passive and 28 active products, and marks continued momentum for Taiwan's fast-growing active ETF segment even as the broader market sells off.

items.title_zh: WWDC登場，蘋果新品傳亮相、台積電受惠
items.title_en: WWDC in focus: new Apple hardware seen benefiting TSMC
items.summary_zh: 蘋果全球開發者大會（WWDC）6月9日登場，市場預期搭載M5 Ultra晶片的新款Mac Studio有望成為亮點之一。供應鏈看法認為，新品將帶動台積電N3P先進製程與SoIC-mH先進封裝需求看升；同時macOS 27強化觸控操作的方向，預期推升OLED驅動IC規格升級，連帶使台積電16奈米特殊製程受惠。對台股而言，蘋果新品週期向來是先進製程與封裝供應鏈的重要催化劑，惟實際拉貨力道仍須觀察新品定價、市場接受度與後續備貨節奏，短線股價也易受大盤系統性風險干擾，宜分辨題材與基本面落差。
items.summary_en: Apple's Worldwide Developers Conference opens June 9, with the market anticipating a new Mac Studio powered by the M5 Ultra chip among the headline reveals. Supply-chain watchers expect demand to firm for TSMC's N3P advanced node and SoIC-mH packaging, while a macOS 27 push toward enhanced touch capability is seen driving upgrades in OLED driver ICs, benefiting TSMC's 16nm specialty process. The event reinforces Apple's role as a key swing factor for Taiwan's advanced-process and packaging supply chain.

items.title_zh: 緯致5月營收年增29.2%，續創同期新高
items.title_en: 緯致 May revenue up 29.2%, a fresh same-period high
items.summary_zh: 緯致（原緯創軟體）公告自結5月合併營收11.49億元，續創歷年同期新高。受新台幣升值及工作天數較少影響，營收月減7.4%，但年增達29.2%；累計今年前5月合併營收57.89億元、年增29.7%，動能維持強勁。公司並連續六年獲評為上櫃公司治理評鑑前5%，顯示營運成長與治理品質兼具。對投資人而言，軟體與資訊服務類股營收受匯率與工作天數的短期擾動屬常態，重點仍在年增趨勢與專案動能是否延續；在大盤回檔之際，基本面穩健、年增雙位數的中小型成長股，較具相對抗跌韌性，惟仍須留意整體市場資金情緒。
items.summary_en: 緯致 (formerly 緯創軟體) reported self-compiled May consolidated revenue of NT$1.149 billion, a record for the month. Revenue slipped 7.4% month-on-month on the stronger New Taiwan dollar and fewer working days, but rose 29.2% year-on-year, taking cumulative January-May revenue to NT$5.789 billion, up 29.7%. The company has been rated among the top 5% in corporate governance among OTC-listed firms for six consecutive years, underscoring steady operational and governance momentum.

items.title_zh: 保瑞5月營收21.14億元創新高，併購綜效顯現
items.title_en: 保瑞 May revenue hits record on US brand acquisition
items.summary_zh: 保瑞（6472）公告5月自結合併營收21.14億元，年增40.19%、月增42.46%，雙雙改寫歷史新高。成長主要來自旗下晨暉於5月以5,000萬美元現金完成收購美國運動保健品牌Weider Global Nutrition（WGN），併購綜效逐步反映於營收，推升單月表現大幅跳升。保瑞長期以「併購＋CDMO（委託開發暨製造）」雙引擎驅動成長，此次跨入運動營養保健領域，進一步擴大消費保健版圖。對投資人而言，併購題材帶動營收高基期成長，後續仍須觀察整併效益、毛利結構與財務槓桿變化，評估成長動能是否能延續至下半年。
items.summary_en: Pharma group 保瑞 (6472) posted self-compiled May consolidated revenue of NT$2.114 billion, up 40.19% year-on-year and 42.46% month-on-month, an all-time high. The jump was driven by its 晨暉 unit completing a US$50 million cash acquisition of US sports-nutrition brand Weider Global Nutrition (WGN) in May, with merger synergies feeding through to top-line growth. The result underlines 保瑞's acquisition-led growth model in pharmaceuticals and consumer health.

items.title_zh: 生醫概念股成本周資金避風港
items.title_en: Biotech becomes the week's safe haven as chips pull back
items.summary_zh: 在AI、半導體族群漲多承壓之際，法人點名生醫族群有望成為本周資金避風港。藥華藥5月營收24.6億元、月增19.1%、年增108.5%，創歷史新高；今年有逾11家上市櫃及興櫃公司設定新藥授權目標，題材延續。7月中旬生技月即將啟動，預估媒合場次上看破萬場、攤位達2,200個，可望帶動族群人氣。法人並看好保瑞、美時等藥廠下半年營運表現。生醫股具防禦與題材雙重特性，在系統性風險升高時相對抗跌，惟個股基本面與新藥進度差異大，投資人宜聚焦營收動能明確、授權或產品線具體者，避免追逐純題材、缺乏獲利支撐的標的。
items.summary_en: With AI and semiconductor names overbought and under pressure, institutions flagged the biomedical sector as this week's likely safe harbour. 藥華藥 posted record May revenue of NT$2.46 billion, up 19.1% month-on-month and 108.5% year-on-year. More than 11 listed, OTC and emerging-board firms are targeting new-drug licensing deals this year, and the mid-July biotech month is expected to host over 10,000 matchmaking sessions across 2,200 booths. 保瑞 and 美時 are seen as having promising second-half operations.

items.title_zh: 期交所6/9起辦說明會，宣導兩大避險新制
items.title_en: TAIFEX rolls out briefings from June 9 ahead of two new rules
items.summary_zh: 台指期夜盤重挫3,006點（跌幅6.65%），創期交所盤後交易最大單日跌點紀錄，凸顯極端行情下的價格保護需求。期交所將自6月9日至6月26日於台北、台中、高雄、新竹巡迴舉辦6場說明會，宣導7月6日上路的兩大新制：一是股票期貨最小升降單位調整，將1元最小單位擴大適用至500至2,500元級距的股期；二是國外ETF期貨及選擇權改採三階段漲跌幅機制，提供更細緻的價格保護，避免恐慌性超跌或超漲。對交易人而言，新制將影響下單成本、跳動值與停損規劃，建議於正式上路前完整了解規則細節，重新檢視部位與風險控管參數。
items.summary_en: After the night session saw TAIEX futures crash 3,006 points (down 6.65%), the largest single-day after-hours point drop on record, the Taiwan Futures Exchange will hold six briefing sessions from June 9 to June 26 across Taipei, Taichung, Kaohsiung and Hsinchu. The sessions explain two rules taking effect July 6: an adjustment to the minimum tick size for single-stock futures (the NT$1 minimum extended to the NT$500-2,500 price band) and a three-stage daily price-limit mechanism for foreign-ETF futures and options, aimed at cushioning panic-driven overshoots.

items.title_zh: 金管會設壽險海外公債BBB-門檻，3,744億踩線
items.title_en: Regulator sets BBB- floor for insurers' foreign sovereign bonds
items.summary_zh: 金管會6月2日預告修法，未來壽險業投資海外政府公債及國庫券，信用評等須達BBB-投資等級以上；若既有部位遭降評至非投資等級，則禁止再加碼。截至今年3月底，保險業持有外國政府公債約2.88兆元，其中評等低於BBB-的部位約3,744億元、占比約13%，落入警戒區。既有部位給予6個月調整期、不強制處分，屆期未改善者須提出改善計畫與風險管理機制，新制最快8月底上路。全案起因於哥倫比亞主權債遭降評，引發各界關注壽險業重押新興市場主權債的信用風險，金管會因此啟動制度檢討，強化海外固定收益部位的信評把關。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has pre-announced rules requiring life insurers' holdings of foreign government bonds and treasury bills to carry at least a BBB- investment-grade rating; positions downgraded to junk cannot be added to. As of end-March insurers held about NT$2.88 trillion of foreign sovereign debt, of which roughly NT$374.4 billion (about 13%) sat below BBB-, now in the warning zone. Existing positions get a six-month adjustment window without forced sales, with the rule set to take effect as early as end-August. The review was triggered by a downgrade of Colombian sovereign debt.

items.title_zh: 金管會盯境外地下保單，鎖定IG、LINE兜售香港保單
items.title_en: FSC steps up scrutiny of offshore policies sold on social media
items.summary_zh: 金管會保險局指出，近期檢舉案件多與香港保單有關，主要透過Instagram、Facebook、LINE等社群平台招攬，近兩個月已接獲2件檢舉，明顯高於過去約每半年1件的頻率，顯示違規招攬有上升趨勢。金管會示警未經核准的境外保單潛藏五大風險：爭議難解、資訊不對稱、法律保障不足、詐騙風險，以及無法適用保險相關稅負優惠。境外地下保單常見四大特徵：以英文標示保險公司名稱、保單條款為英文、保費多以外幣收取，且缺乏台灣合法保險公司核准文號。依保險法規定，未經許可在境內代理、經紀或招攬境外保單，最重可處三年以下有期徒刑，並得併科罰金，民眾切勿購買。
items.summary_en: The FSC's Insurance Bureau says recent complaints have centred on Hong Kong insurance policies promoted via Instagram, Facebook and LINE, with two complaint cases in the past two months versus a prior pace of about one every six months. The regulator flagged five major risks of unapproved offshore policies — hard-to-resolve disputes, information asymmetry, weak legal protection, fraud risk and ineligibility for tax incentives — and warned that illegally representing, broking or soliciting such policies domestically can carry up to three years' imprisonment.

items.title_zh: 指數連結型保單年底前開放，金管會畫定五大遊戲規則
items.title_en: FSC maps out five rules for index-linked policies due to open by year-end
items.summary_zh: 金管會規劃在今年底前開放指數連結型保單在台銷售，並訂出五大規範：一是連結指數須為IOSCO會員國中「先進國家」的指數；二是該指數須已有三年以上市場交易紀錄；三是銷售人員須具備三年以上投資型保單銷售經驗；四是每張投資型保單最多僅能連結5個指數；五是須具保本機制。金管會願意開放，主因包括配合亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區成立、須有更多元商品，以及觀察美國、新加坡、香港經驗，此類商品在高淨值資產客群相當熱銷。對財管與高資產客群而言，保本＋指數參與的設計兼顧防禦與成長，惟連結標的、參與率、保本條件與費用結構差異大，規劃前仍須回到客戶風險屬性與資產配置全局評估，避免僅看「保本」二字。
items.summary_en: Regulators are preparing to allow index-linked insurance policies to be sold in Taiwan by the end of this year, setting five guardrails: the linked index must come from an "advanced" IOSCO-member jurisdiction; it must have at least three years of trading history; sales staff must have three years' investment-linked policy experience; each policy may link to a maximum of five indices; and principal must be protected. The move responds to the Kaohsiung asset-management hub initiative and to strong high-net-worth demand seen in the US, Singapore and Hong Kong.

items.title_zh: 凱基投信：AI台鏈迎結構性機遇
items.title_en: 凱基投信: AI Taiwan supply chain faces structural opportunity
items.summary_zh: 凱基投信指出，受惠AI浪潮的台灣科技供應鏈，正進入「結構性」而非僅「景氣循環」的成長機遇期；即便近期晶片與AI股大幅回檔，背後的長線投資主軸並未改變。投信認為，當前波動主要來自降息預期重新定價與部位過度擁擠所致，屬於長期結構性多頭趨勢中的修正，而非趨勢反轉；AI基礎建設投資、先進封裝與伺服器需求仍是中長期支撐。對財管客戶與基金投資人而言，此觀點提供在急殺段「危機入市」的思考框架，但仍須留意評價是否合理、產業地位是否穩固，並透過分批布局與資產配置分散單一題材風險，避免在高波動環境中過度集中押注單一族群。
items.summary_en: 凱基投信 argues the AI-driven Taiwan technology supply chain is entering a phase of structural, rather than merely cyclical, opportunity, even after the recent sharp pullback in chip and AI names. The fund house frames near-term volatility — driven by rate-cut repricing and crowded positioning — as a reset within a longer structural uptrend tied to AI infrastructure build-out, advanced packaging and server demand, suggesting longer-horizon investors treat sharp corrections as allocation opportunities rather than trend reversals.

items.title_zh: 科技股最危險時刻？美銀示警CPI、Fed、SpaceX三重夾殺
items.title_en: BofA warns of a "most dangerous moment" for tech on triple threat
items.summary_zh: 美銀策略師Hartnett警告科技股面臨三大風險交織。其一，6月10日將公布的5月CPI：歷史經驗顯示，當通膨年增率突破4%時，標普500指數其後三個月平均下跌約4%。其二，全球央行可能進一步緊縮，推升公債殖利率，對評價偏高的成長股形成壓力。其三，SpaceX、Anthropic、OpenAI等重量級新股可能掀起IPO熱潮，抽走市場流動性，使資金從既有龍頭股分流，對原已擁擠的科技股交易形成雪上加霜的壓力。對投資人而言，此提醒呼應近期費半與台股的劇烈震盪，短線須留意CPI數據、殖利率走向與資金板塊輪動，在科技股漲多階段適度控管部位、預留現金以因應波動。
items.summary_en: Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett flagged three converging risks for technology stocks. First, the May CPI due June 10: historically, when annual inflation runs above 4%, the S&P 500 has averaged a roughly 4% decline over the following three months. Second, central banks may tighten further, pushing bond yields higher and pressuring richly valued growth names. Third, a wave of high-profile IPOs from the likes of SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI threatens to drain market liquidity away from incumbents, compounding the squeeze on an already crowded tech trade.

items.title_zh: 〈美股盤後〉非農爆表重創降息夢，費半狂瀉超10%、台積電ADR摔逾6%
items.title_en: Blowout US payrolls torch rate-cut hopes; chips lead Wall Street rout
items.summary_zh: 美國5月新增非農就業17.2萬人，遠超市場預估的約8萬人，重新點燃Fed維持緊縮、甚至進一步升息的疑慮，風險性資產全面承壓。費半指數崩跌10.26%，那斯達克指數重挫4.2%、創去年4月以來最大單日跌幅，標普500指數下跌2.6%、終止連九週上漲，道瓊則跌1.35%。台積電ADR大跌6.69%，10年期美債殖利率同步突破4.5%，顯示強勁就業數據同時衝擊股、債兩市。這波由就業數據觸發的修正，是引爆台股6月8日盤中歷史性急殺的關鍵外部利空；投資人後續須緊盯6月10日CPI與Fed官員談話，研判降息預期能否重建。
items.summary_en: US nonfarm payrolls rose 172,000 in May, far above the roughly 80,000 expected, reigniting fears the Fed will stay tight or even tighten further. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 10.26%, the Nasdaq fell 4.2% (its worst day since April last year), the S&P 500 dropped 2.6% to end a nine-week winning streak, and the Dow lost 1.35%. TSMC's ADR sank 6.69%, while the 10-year US Treasury yield pushed above 4.5%, underscoring how a hot labour market jolted both equities and bonds.

items.title_zh: 美股反彈、晶片股回穩，英特爾、特斯拉領漲
items.title_en: US stocks rebound as chips recover; Intel and Tesla lead gainers
items.summary_zh: 美股週一收高，晶片股自上週五重挫中反彈，標普500上漲0.30%至7,405.73點、那指漲0.86%至25,929.66點，道瓊小跌0.16%至50,786點。英特爾因傳出Alphabet下單委由其於2028年製造逾300萬顆TPU，股價大漲約10%至109.03美元；特斯拉受惠5月中國零售銷售年增22.5%，上漲約2.8%。
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed higher Monday as chip stocks bounced from Friday's rout, while the Dow slipped 0.16% to 50,786. The S&P added 0.30% to 7,405.73 and the Nasdaq rose 0.86% to 25,929.66. Intel surged about 10% to $109.03 on reports Alphabet ordered it to manufacture more than three million TPUs in 2028, and Tesla rose about 2.8% as China retail sales climbed 22.5% year-on-year in May.

items.title_zh: 以色列襲伊朗石化廠，油價勁揚近5%
items.title_en: Israel strikes Iranian petrochemical plant; oil jumps nearly 5%
items.summary_zh: 以色列空襲伊朗西南部Mahshahr石化園區，為4月8日停火以來首度攻擊伊朗能源設施，並稱該廠生產伊朗飛彈計畫所需原料。此舉使布蘭特原油期貨重返每桶97美元之上、勁揚近5%。據報導，美國總統川普稍早曾敦促以色列總理納坦雅胡暫緩進一步攻擊，但情勢仍升溫，市場對荷莫茲海峽供應中斷的疑慮再起。
items.summary_en: Israel struck the Mahshahr petrochemical complex in southwestern Iran, its first hit on an Iranian energy site since the April 8 ceasefire, saying it produces materials for Iran's missile programme. The escalation pushed Brent crude futures back above $97 a barrel, up nearly 5%, after President Trump reportedly urged Prime Minister Netanyahu to hold off on further attacks.

items.title_zh: 以色列與伊朗互射飛彈後各自收手
items.title_en: Israel and Iran pull back after trading missile fire
items.summary_zh: 以色列與伊朗週末互射飛彈後雙方暫時收手，葉門青年運動（Houthi）武裝也向以色列發射飛彈。這波交火一度使停滯數月的衝突有重燃為全面戰爭之虞，令能源與股市的地緣政治風險維持高檔，投資人持續關注停火能否守住。
items.summary_en: Israel and Iran traded missile fire over the weekend before pulling back, with Yemen's Houthi rebels also firing at Israel. The exchanges threatened to drag the region back toward full-scale war after months of a stalled conflict, keeping geopolitical risk elevated for energy and equity markets.

items.title_zh: 以色列在川普勸阻後仍襲伊朗軍事與能源目標
items.title_en: Israel hits Iranian military and energy targets after Trump reprimand
items.summary_zh: 以色列在區域緊張升高之際對伊朗軍事目標展開報復，除石化廠外亦攻擊其他據點。此波再度動武發生於有報導指出川普已要求納坦雅胡克制進一步攻擊之後，市場對荷莫茲海峽潛在供應中斷的疑慮再度升高，地緣風險溢價支撐油價。
items.summary_en: Israel retaliated against Iranian military targets amid rising tensions, striking a petrochemical plant alongside other sites. The renewed strikes followed reports that President Trump had told PM Netanyahu to refrain from further attacks, raising fresh concerns about potential supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz.
